It is truly heartwarming to witness the cinematic miracle where teenagers, burdened by the crushing weight of algebra and social anxiety, simply stop mid-sentence to harmonize in perfect pitch. Who needs therapy or conflict resolution when you have a well-timed key change? It is a comforting thought that the complex socio-economic disparities of the modern world can be neatly resolved by a choreographed routine involving matching outfits and synchronized arm movements. Why engage in the messy, unglamorous work of actual communication when you can just out-dance your problems until they disappear into the background chorus?

But let us not get too distracted by the absurdity of a society that believes a dance-off is a viable substitute for dialogue. Let us instead focus on the tangible reality that anchors us to the earth, quite literally.
